## September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 717)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata declarations, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across five classic serial storylines created by Carlton E. Morse on *I Love a Mystery* spanning 1939 to 1952 (featuring Jack Packard and Doc Long tackling San Francisco conspirators, Nicaraguan vampire bat tombs, Arizona desert snipers, penthouse gilded cages, and Chinatown opium cobra assassins), alongside William N. Robson's Peabody Award-winning WWII docudrama on the Allied airborne invasion of Sicily on *The Man Behind the Gun*, Carlton E. Morse (1939, 1944, 1950, 1951, 1952), and William N.
